scope: Season kit colours (home/away/third) for the audited Premier team-seasons, 1992/93-2025/26, copied from English Wikipedia season articles. Base colours only: stripes, hoops and trims live in the Wikipedia pattern images named in patterns, which are not included.

attribution.text: Kit colours and pattern names from English Wikipedia season articles ({{Football kit}} templates and infobox kit parameters) by Wikipedia contributors, licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Each entry links the article and revision used. Changes: colours normalised to #RRGGBB; empty or invalid source values kept as null.
attribution.material: Football kit template parameters (leftarm, body, rightarm, shorts, socks, pattern_*)
attribution.rights: Share-alike applies to this compiled data. Club kit designs and crests remain the property of their owners.

fields.patterns: Wikipedia kit pattern image suffixes (la=left arm, b=body, ra=right arm, sh=shorts, so=socks); null when absent
fields.null_fields: role.field colours that the source leaves empty or invalid; not inferred
fields.partial: flag carried from extraction when the season is known to be incomplete
